summary: User Management Phase 1 - All tests passed. Backend: 16/16 tests (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified working correctly. Admin CRUD users, module-wise permissions, sidebar filtering based on permissions all working.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

GET /api/auth/me - Returns user with permissions field
POST /api/auth/login - Quality inspector login includes restricted permissions
GET /api/users - Admin can list all users with permissions (no password_hash exposed)
GET /api/users/modules - Returns 13 modules, 4 actions, and default permission presets for 4 roles
POST /api/users - Admin can create new user with role and default permissions
PUT /api/users/{id} - Admin can update user name, role, permissions
PUT /api/users/{id} - Admin can update user password (verified with login)
DELETE /api/users/{id} - Admin can delete user
DELETE /api/users/{id} - Admin cannot delete their own account (400 returned)
GET /api/users - Quality inspector gets 403 (Insufficient permissions)
POST /api/users - Quality inspector gets 403
PUT /api/users/{id} - Quality inspector gets 403
DELETE /api/users/{id} - Quality inspector gets 403

User Management page - shows users table with Name, Email, Role, Status, Created, Actions columns
Add User dialog - has Name, Email, Password, Role fields
Permissions dialog - shows 13 modules x 4 actions checkbox grid
Permissions dialog - has Reset to Role Defaults and Save Permissions buttons
Admin sidebar - shows all 14 navigation items (13 modules + User Management)
Quality Inspector sidebar - shows only 9 navigation items (no MRP, Suppliers, Customers, Purchase Orders, User Management)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing admin and quality inspector users
context_for_next_testing_agent: User Management Phase 1 fully implemented and tested. Admin can CRUD users at /api/users endpoints. Users stored in MongoDB with permissions field. Quality inspector has restricted permissions (no MRP, Suppliers, Customers, Purchase Orders). Sidebar dynamically filters based on hasPermission helper in AuthContext. 13 modules: dashboard, items, bom, mrp, production, manufacturing, quality, inventory, suppliers, customers, purchase_orders, stores, settings. 4 actions: view, create, edit, delete. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_user_management.py

endpoints.GET /api/users: Admin only - returns all users with permissions (no password_hash)
endpoints.POST /api/users: Admin only - creates user with role and default permissions
endpoints.PUT /api/users/{id}: Admin only - updates name, role, password, permissions, status
endpoints.DELETE /api/users/{id}: Admin only - deletes user (cannot delete self)
endpoints.GET /api/users/modules: Any authenticated user - returns modules, actions, default_permissions

roles.production_manager: Most modules with view/create/edit, limited delete
roles.quality_inspector: View-only on most modules, view+create+edit on quality, no MRP/Suppliers/Customers/Purchase Orders
roles.inventory_manager: Full inventory/stores access, view on most others

user_management_implementation_details.sidebar_filtering: Layout.js uses hasPermission(module, 'view') to filter navigation items. Admin sees all 14 items (13 modules + User Management). Quality inspector sees 9 items.
